hand_read.summary: Tiki Buzz (Kirby). Hovers 35 units above fighter 0 (aerial homing extend), searches below itself every 30 frames; finds a fighter: a 0.75x hold, then dives at 6 units a frame (the only hitbox) for 9 frames, brakes, or lands (quake) and takes off again; leaves after 900 frames; stepped on: drops and vanishes.
hand_read.read: enemy_fs.cro (update): create 0x78630, ctor 0x787B8 (no hashsets; damage labels DamageStart .. DownWait, Fly), start 0x778A8, initialize 0x77DC8 (energy +0x44 = P0 f18), states: 1 0x77BD8 / 0x77E10, 2 0x77C80 / 0x7806C, 3 0x78668 / 0x77A2C, 4 0x780A4 / 0x78410, 5 0x77964 / 0x77CB0, 6 0x78240 / 0x784B4, 7 0x78454 / 0x78554, 8 0x77D7C / 0x78204, 9 0x7781C / 0x77C40, 10 0x77F04 / 0x78388, 11 0x77E50 / 0x78378, 12 remove; slot 21 0x77C30 (=> 10), slots 11 / 60 (meshes only); 64-66 = 3, 67 = 2. code.bin: set_mode_homing 0x5F59C4 / homing_extend 0x5F60F0, set_mode_none 0x5F58C8, set_mode_braking 0x5F5B48, set_mode_uniform 0x5F5BD4, update 0x5F66AC (jump table 0x5F66E4: mode 5 does nothing).

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, ground off, Fly loop; on the ground -> 3.
states.2: Dead: DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(); kinetic flag 8 -> 12.
states.3: Fly: ground off, passable on, Y = y, Fly loop, set_mode_homing_extend(f3 0.05, f4 0.11, f7 0.05, f8 0.06, f5 0.5, f6 1.1), aerial +0x54 = 1, +0x5C = 0, +0x58 = -1, set_target(fighter 0, (0, f1 35, 0)), counter 0, meshes normal. Update: aerial update; MotionModule +0x50 = f9 (1) rising / f10 (0.2) not; Y = y; cool-down > 0: -1; else every search-0 interval (30) frames of the counter search_target(0) ({2, 30, 15, 60, 0, -25}) -> 4, cool-down int(f17 152), return; counter < f2 (900): +1, else -> 9.
states.4: Hold: ground off, passable on, AttackHold at f11 (0.75), set_mode_none, kinetic 11, V = fighter 0's y, play_se 0x89C0000; aerial update; end -> 5.
states.5: Dive: ground off, passable on, Attack loop, set_mode_uniform((0, -f12 6)), counter 0, play_se 0x89C0001; aerial update; y <= V: passable off; on the ground => 7; counter < f13 (9): +1, else -> 6.
states.6: Brake: ground off, passable on, AttackBrake at f16 (0.7), set_mode_braking(0, f15 0.04), +0x1F0 = -1; aerial update; on the ground: speed 0, set_mode_none, end -> 3; in the air: speed y >= 0 -> 3.
states.7: Landed: ground on, AttackUnguard, set_mode_none, counter 0, request_quake(3); aerial update; counter < f14 (45): +1, else -> 8.
states.8: Ready: ground off, FlyReady, set_mode_none; end -> 3.
states.9: Leave: ground off, passable on, Fly loop, set_correct(0), set_mode_none, timer P@0x78 200; aerial update; timer out -> 12.
states.10: Stomped (slot 21): ground off, passable on, Step, create_dead_item(1, 10), disable_hit, counter 0, set_mode_uniform((0, -f19 3)), meshes damage 2, effect 0x70F0000 at the position, play_se 0x89C0002; aerial update; counter < f20 (60) and not on the ground: +1, else -> 11.
states.11: Gone: kinetic 26, ground on, passable on, set_visibility(0), effect 0x70F0001, play_se 0x89C0003; -> 12.

danger.note: node 2 = jtb entry 1 = RotN; the dive only

hand_read.contact: only in the dive (state 5: power 2, angle 60, kbg 120, fkb 50, size 4, node 2, y -1) and the defeated body (state 2). No explicit attack calls; no ACMD.
hand_read.targeting: aerial homing toward fighter 0 + (0, 35, 0); search group 0 every 30 frames (a 15 x 60 box 25 below it); start faces the nearest fighter.
hand_read.kinetics: setters (code.bin): every one = the mode, energy 0 vt+0xC(0x17, speed, 0, acc) (Wii U vt+0x1C, vptr +0x1C), energy 0 on / 1 off: homing speed 0 (homing_extend = homing + mode 3), slip homing the current speed, none (-1) 0, braking (4) the current speed + params +0x18 / +0x1C, uniform (5) the given speed; the update's mode 5 does nothing (the speed set once).
hand_read.death: state 2 (bullet); stomped: 10 -> 11 -> removed (create_dead_item: kill and item drop); leave: 9 after 900 fly frames.
hand_read.not_ported: start's GroundCollisionObject +0x141 = 4 / +0x142 = 0 and set_circle_follow_node(2) (the Wii U collision object's layout differs past +0x100; not mapped); the flap rate (MotionModule +0x50); meshes (set_mesh_visibility) and set_visibility(0); play_se.
